requirements.text: User can scan medication bottle barcode using phone camera
requirements.notes: scan.tsx implemented, but the camera path can only be exercised on a real device. Native SMOKE-001 is capability-blocked here.

requirements.text: Scanned barcode auto-populates drug details if found in local inventory or previous import
requirements.notes: matchToTemplate aligns counted items to the template by name - asserted by UNIT-001 this turn.

requirements.text: If barcode not found, prompt manual entry with barcode pre-filled
requirements.notes: Routing exists but the barcode-prefilled manual-entry path has no component test yet.

requirements.text: Manual entry form for all veterinary drug fields (name, generic, manufacturer, concentration, form, size, category, location, expiration, lot, controlled, unit)
requirements.notes: add.tsx implements the full field set and typechecks, but no component test renders it yet (oi-002 also covers its missing a11y labels).

requirements.text: Quantity on hand entry adds to count (add mode) with option to set/override
requirements.notes: mergeInventories "add" strategy sums quantities instead of replacing (UNIT-001), and the +1 control routes to /add with mode=addQty (COMPONENT-001).

requirements.text: Inventory list with search/filter by name/barcode/location and shows current counts
requirements.notes: Now genuinely asserted at the component level: items render with their quantity, search narrows by drug name, and search by barcode works. Location-filter chips render and are labelled, but filtering by location is not yet asserted.

requirements.text: Excel import: parse template file and load into app
requirements.notes: lib/storage/excel.ts parse path has no test coverage.

requirements.text: Excel export: generate file with columns in exact template order, only qty intended for edit
requirements.notes: TEMPLATE_COLUMNS order and itemToTemplateRow are unit-tested, but the actual xlsx serialization and the Instructions sheet are untested, and oi-001 (exact master columns) is still open.

requirements.text: Multi-phone compile: import multiple exported files and merge (add quantities for existing, add new items)
requirements.notes: mergeInventories add/replace plus name-only matching are all asserted by UNIT-001.

requirements.text: Offline-first: all counting works without network
requirements.notes: SMOKE-001 web: the dev server starts with --offline (networking disabled), storage is AsyncStorage-only, and SEC-001 confirms no network calls in the bundle. Web target only.

requirements.text: Final export ready to copy into protected master template
requirements.notes: Blocked by oi-001 - the protected master column order is still unconfirmed, so "ready to copy in" cannot be claimed.
